data.action: 在古老藏书库的高书架前伸手取一本旧书
data.description: 【圣园未花 · 古老藏书库的秘密】静谧古老的旧藏书库角落，未花踮起脚尖在高高的书架前找寻着什么，粉发随动作轻扬，金瞳在烛光下熠熠生辉。她回头冲你俏皮地眨了眨眼——「嘘——老师，这是我们两个人的秘密探险哦，绝对不能告诉渚酱她们～」
data.promptProse: Mika rises onto her toes before a tall shelf in the old library, searching among its upper books before turning to wink at the viewer. Her white-and-gold ballgown and shawl retain their formal shape in the eye-level medium view. Shelves overlap behind her toward the secluded corner. Candlelight brightens her fingertips and gold trim, casting book-spine shadows across the darker wood beyond her reach.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 古老藏书库的秘密
